description: “I have never picked a job because it was fun,” Dievendorf said. “I think that civil rights, I think that's what politics should be — I think politics is supposed to be about representation. And, to me, this is making sure the community is in the office.“I always say I'm an easy Google. And when you Google me, you're going to find a lot of people who love me and a lot of people who hate me, and the people who hate me, I am happy with it. Because they are the same folks who are working very hard
